headline: NDTV updates NSE on GoodTimes Channel acquisition
sum: NDTV has filed a general update with NSE regarding its acquisition of GoodTimes Channel, signalling progress in the broadcaster's strategic expansion into the entertainment genre beyond its core news portfolio.
detail: New Delhi Television Limited (NDTV), a major Indian news and media broadcaster, has informed the NSE of developments in its acquisition of GoodTimes Channel, an entertainment broadcaster. The disclosure was filed on 18 June 2026 under the Listing Regulations. Specific transaction value, acquisition percentage, conditions precedent and expected completion date are not detailed in the NSE disclosure document itself, indicating this is a routine corporate governance update rather than a full transaction announcement. The move reflects NDTV's strategy to diversify its channel portfolio and revenue streams beyond news and current affairs programming.
